summary: Eight concrete, comment-endorsed tools and projects from a verified complete HN front-page comment crawl.

items.name: Muse Glimmer 30B
items.source_story_title: Muse Glimmer: 30B-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows
items.summary: A 30B local agentic model with encouraging early hands-on reports.
items.why_included: A commenter reported good local results on a 32GB Mac mini, while another cited promising early comparisons with Qwen 3.6 27B.
items.evidence: One early user got good local results, though slowly; another reported encouraging but still preliminary testing signals.

evidence_sources.author: mark_l_watson
evidence_sources.excerpt: Starting this morning I am running their new local 30B model muse-glimmer on my old MacMini 32G using Ollama

items.name: Docker Sandboxes
items.source_story_title: Docker Sandboxes – Disposable, isolated sandboxes for AI agents
items.summary: A microVM-based agent sandbox with outbound firewall and placeholder secret injection.
items.why_included: A daily user called it effective out of the box for worktree-based agent workflows, despite the login requirement.
items.evidence: A commenter uses it daily with git worktrees and praised its outbound firewall and secret-injection features.

evidence_sources.author: rusch
evidence_sources.excerpt: this has been my daily driver for a while now because it works great out of the box with two key features: outbound firewall and secret injection with placeholders.

items.name: oMLX
items.source_story_title: Muse Glimmer: 30B-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows
items.summary: An Apple Silicon local-model runtime with UMA and NVMe caching optimizations.
items.why_included: It was explicitly recommended as a high-performance Apple Silicon project for local model work.
items.evidence: A commenter recommended oMLX for its Apple Silicon performance optimizations.

evidence_sources.author: reilly3000
evidence_sources.excerpt: try oMLX or vMLX - both great projects that offer some amazing performance optimizations for Apple Silicon

items.name: vMLX
items.source_story_title: Muse Glimmer: 30B-parameter model optimized for always-on local agent workflows
items.summary: An Apple Silicon local-model runtime with UMA and NVMe caching optimizations.
items.why_included: It was explicitly recommended alongside oMLX for local-model performance work on Apple Silicon.
items.evidence: A commenter recommended vMLX for its Apple Silicon performance optimizations.

evidence_sources.author: reilly3000
evidence_sources.excerpt: try oMLX or vMLX - both great projects that offer some amazing performance optimizations for Apple Silicon

items.name: Cuis Smalltalk
items.summary: A simplified Smalltalk system with a vector-graphics, high-DPI Morphic UI.
items.why_included: It received a direct recommendation as a modernized Squeak-derived environment with crisp, flexible live UI tooling.
items.evidence: A commenter recommended Cuis and highlighted its vector-graphics UI; another confirmed its high-DPI support.

evidence_sources.author: isr
evidence_sources.excerpt: Can I suggest you take a look at Cuis Smalltalk (a simplified fork from squeak)

evidence_sources.author: adius
evidence_sources.excerpt: Cuis Smalltalk has full high-DPI support as its GUI is based on vector graphics

items.name: Whodunnit AI
items.source_story_title: Show HN: Voice driven murder mystery, Interview AI suspects with your voice
items.summary: A voice-driven murder mystery where players interview AI suspects.
items.why_included: Multiple commenters independently described the experience as engaging and fun rather than a thin AI demo.
items.evidence: One player said it kept them hooked, and another simply called it really fun.

evidence_sources.author: aswegs8
evidence_sources.excerpt: Kept me hooked, even though I am not a crime nut.

evidence_sources.author: dbx842
evidence_sources.excerpt: This is really fun, great work!

items.name: Sonic Pi
items.summary: A free code-based music creation and live-performance tool.
items.why_included: A long-time user called it a favorite project and said they regularly recommend it to others.
items.evidence: A user said Sonic Pi is a favorite project that lets them make cool work despite limited musical experience.

evidence_sources.author: fmo91
evidence_sources.excerpt: This is one of my favorite software projects.

items.name: EinkBro
items.source_story_title: Ask HN: In your experience, what are sound conventions for e-ink UI development?
items.summary: An Android browser designed around readable, paginated e-ink web browsing.
items.why_included: A daily e-ink user described it as their best Android app discovery and essential for e-ink web browsing.
items.evidence: A commenter called EinkBro their best Android app discovery and an e-ink browsing essential.

evidence_sources.author: dredmorbius
evidence_sources.excerpt: Einkbro is easily the best app I've found for Android (save Termux), and an absolute essential for e-ink Web browsing.
